ns2:section.sectionText: This section is for MCS Chicago. The course will be taught on the Coursera platform. Students taking a credit-bearing Illinois course on the Coursera platform for the first-time must complete a short onboarding course to gain course access. Additional information is available at https://ws.engr.illinois.edu/sitemanager/getfile.asp?id=3552. There will be no late adds after 10th day. For up-to-date information about CS course restrictions, please see the following link: http://go.cs.illinois.edu/csregister. Weekly in-person meeting in 200 S. Wacker Dr.
